docs.summary: Stores a single per-instance property override for a prefab instance.

Which member of which object this overrides, relative to the instance root.

Format: `{objectSourceId}/{componentSourceId}/{memberPath}`, or `{objectSourceId}/$/{memberPath}` for a member of the GameObject itself. The source identifiers say which prefab object each part addresses, so the path survives objects being added, removed or reordered on either side.
The overridden value, serialized as an EchoObject.
